dedupe_keys.name: dnit sistema nacional de viacao snv brazil s federal road network base with segment codes surface and jurisdiction

description: The Sistema Nacional de Viação (SNV) is the official base of Brazil's federal transport network, maintained by the Departamento Nacional de Infraestrutura de Transportes (DNIT) under the national transport plan law (Lei 12.379/2011). Contents: the federal highway network divided into SNV segments, each with its code, highway number, start and end points, length, surface situation (paved, duplicated, unpaved, planned), jurisdiction (federal, delegated, concession) and changes such as absorptions, disposals and concessions, plus a list of SNV waterways; DNIT keeps the archive of past editions and the legal acts that modify the network. Coverage: the whole of Brazil; editions are published several times a year (the INDE catalogue lists the July 2025 edition as layer snv_202507a). Format and access: shapefiles and spreadsheets in the PNV and SNV archive on DNIT's cloud, and the layer as a WMS on the INDE GeoServer (geoservicos.inde.gov.br, workspace DNIT). Free; licence not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the SNV covers federal and coincident state highways only, not the municipal network, and geometry is aligned to DNIT's own base, not to imagery. Simulation uses: the reference road network for freight and traffic network flow models, criticality and hazard exposure of Brazilian highways; the IBGE freight flow matrices (data-ibge-brazil-logistica-transportes-freight-flows-2024) and IBGE's heavy-vehicle traffic layers use the SNV segments. Related records: DNIT pavement condition data (data-dnit-sistema-de-ger-ncia-de-pavimentos-condi-es-da-malha-rodovi-ria).
